q1.explanationZh: comment 名词、动词同形，表示“评论”，常用 comment on sth.“对某事发表评论”。

q2.explanationZh: commerce 是不可数名词“商业；贸易”，形容词是 commercial。

q3.explanationZh: commerce 的形容词 commercial“商业的”，作名词时指“商业广告”。注意结尾是 -cial。

q4.explanationZh: commit“犯（罪）”，commit a crime“犯罪”；过去式、过去分词双写 t：committed。

q5.explanationZh: commit 加 -ment 构成名词 commitment“承诺”，注意这里 t 不双写。

q6.explanationZh: committee“委员会”，注意双写 m、双写 t、双写 e。

q7.explanationZh: common“普通的；共同的”，have ... in common“有共同之处”。

q8.explanationZh: communicate“交流；传达”，communicate with sb.“与某人沟通”。

q9.explanationZh: communicate 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 communication“交流；通信”。

q10.explanationZh: communist“共产主义的”，the Communist Party of China“中国共产党”。

q11.explanationZh: community“社区；团体”，注意双写 m，结尾 -ity。

q12.explanationZh: companion“同伴，伴侣”，与 company“陪伴”同源。

q13.explanationZh: company 有“公司”和“陪伴”两层意思，keep sb. company“陪伴某人”。

q14.explanationZh: compare 的形容词 comparative“相对的；比较的”，注意是 -rative。

q15.explanationZh: compare“比较”，compare A with B“把 A 和 B 比较”，compare A to B“把 A 比作 B”。

q16.explanationZh: compare 的名词是 comparison“比较”，注意 compar- 后面是 -ison，不是 -eson。

q17.explanationZh: compass“指南针，罗盘”，结尾双写 s。

q18.explanationZh: compete“竞争；比赛”，是不及物动词，常用 compete with/against sb.、compete for sth.。

q19.explanationZh: competence“能力”，词尾 -ence；形容词 competent“有能力的”。

q20.explanationZh: compete 的名词 competition“竞争；比赛”，注意中间是 -peti-。

q21.explanationZh: compete 的形容词 competitive“竞争的；有竞争力的”。

q22.explanationZh: complain“抱怨”，complain to sb. about/of sth.“向某人抱怨某事”。

q23.explanationZh: complain 加 t 构成名词 complaint“抱怨；投诉”。

q24.explanationZh: complete 作动词“完成”，作形容词“完整的；完全的”。

q25.explanationZh: complete 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 completion“完成”。

q26.explanationZh: complex 作形容词“复杂的；组合的”，作名词“综合体”。

q27.explanationZh: complicated“复杂的；难解的”，常指事情纠缠难懂。

q28.explanationZh: compliment“赞美；恭维”，中间是 -pli-，不要与 complement“补充”混淆。

q30.explanationZh: compose“组成；创作”，be composed of“由……组成”。

q31.explanationZh: compose 加 -r 表示人，composer“作曲家”。

q32.explanationZh: compose 的名词 composition“作文；作品；组成”。

q33.explanationZh: compound 名词“复合物；化合物”，形容词“复合的”。

q34.explanationZh: comprehension“理解（力）”，beyond one’s comprehension“超出某人的理解”。

q35.explanationZh: comprehensive“全面的；综合的”，与 comprehension 同根，词尾 -sive。

q37.explanationZh: commercial“商业的”修饰 venture“（有风险的）投资，企业”。

q38.explanationZh: commit 表示“犯（罪、错误）”，commit a crime“犯罪”。

q39.explanationZh: comment on sth.“对某事发表评论”，介词用 on。

q40.explanationZh: in common with“与……一样；与……共同”，have sth. in common with sb.“与某人有共同之处”；写成 have sth. in common with 也算对。

q41.explanationZh: out of the common“非同寻常的”，字面意思是“超出普通的范围”。

q42.explanationZh: common“普通的；共同的”，common sense / common knowledge 都可表示“常识”。

q43.explanationZh: communicate with sb.“与某人联系、沟通”，介词用 with。

q44.explanationZh: “中国共产党”固定说法 the Communist Party of China，Communist 首字母大写。

q45.explanationZh: compare A to B 表示“把 A 比作 B”（打比方），用 to。

q46.explanationZh: compare A with B 表示“把 A 和 B 作比较”，用 with。

q47.explanationZh: by comparison“比较起来”，用名词 comparison。

q49.explanationZh: complain to sb. about/of sth.“向某人抱怨某事”，about 和 of 都可以。

q50.explanationZh: be composed of“由……组成”，用被动形式，相当于 consist of。

q51.explanationZh: compare A to B“把 A 比作 B”；莎士比亚已作过的比喻，用过去式 compared。

q52.explanationZh: 前面有 a，后接 of，需要名词：compound“化合物”。

q53.explanationZh: 狗是老太太唯一的“同伴”，用可数名词 companion。

q54.explanationZh: commit a crime“犯罪”；if 条件句主语是 you，用一般现在时 commit。

q55.explanationZh: keep sb. company“陪伴某人”，company 在这里是不可数名词，不加 s。

q56.explanationZh: 别人对你的“评论”不止一条，用复数 comments；make comments on“对……作评论”。

q57.explanationZh: it is no use doing sth.“做某事没有用”，所以用动名词 complaining。

q58.explanationZh: have a lot in common“有许多共同之处”。

q59.explanationZh: 修饰名词 social life 要用形容词 competitive“竞争激烈的”，前面的 fiercely 是副词修饰它。

q60.explanationZh: the 后需要名词作主语：the competition for employment“就业竞争”；谓语 is，用单数。

q61.sampleAnswer: The teacher refused to comment on the examination results.
references: The teacher refused to comment on the examination results.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: refuse to do sth.“拒绝做某事”，comment on sth.“对某事发表评论”。

q62.sampleAnswer: The case is too complicated to explain in such a short time.
references: The case is too complicated to explain in such a short time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: 用 too ... to do 表示“太……而不能……”；complicated“复杂的”作表语。

q63.sampleAnswer: The winding river, in company with the villagers who have lived in this countryside for generations, has witnessed the village’s changes over time.
references: The winding river, in company with the villagers who have lived in this countryside for generations, has witnessed the village’s changes over time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: in company with“与……一起，陪伴”作插入成分；主句 The winding river has witnessed ...；“世代居住”用 who have lived ... for generations。

q64.sampleAnswer: When it comes to office/workplace conflicts, experts suggest one should reflect more on himself/herself, always put himself/herself in others’ shoes, and communicate with workmates in time.
references: When it comes to office/workplace conflicts, experts suggest one should reflect more on himself/herself, always put himself/herself in others’ shoes, and communicate with workmates in time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: When it comes to ...“当谈到……时”；suggest 后的宾语从句用 (should) do；communicate with sb.“与某人沟通”，put oneself in others’ shoes“换位思考”。

q65.sampleAnswer: To make this product stand out in the fiercely competitive market, the company’s leader suggested integrating traditional culture into the design concept of the product.
references: To make this product stand out in the fiercely competitive market, the company’s leader suggested integrating traditional culture into the design concept of the product.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: To make ... 表目的；fiercely competitive market“竞争激烈的市场”；suggest doing sth.“建议做某事”，integrate A into B“把 A 融入 B”。

q66.sampleAnswer: Many spelling mistakes can be avoided if you check your composition carefully.
references: Many spelling mistakes can be avoided if you check your composition carefully.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “可以避免”用被动 can be avoided；composition“作文”。

q67.sampleAnswer: Compared with other students, the girl has better listening and speaking abilities in English.
references: Compared with other students, the girl has better listening and speaking abilities in English.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: Compared with ... 是过去分词短语作状语，表示“与……相比”；“更强的”用比较级 better。

q68.sampleAnswer: I don’t approve of children competing in China’s Got Talent, which will make them dream of becoming famous overnight.
references: I don’t approve of children competing in China’s Got Talent, which will make them dream of becoming famous overnight.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: approve of sb. doing sth.“赞成某人做某事”，所以用 competing；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整件事。

q69.sampleAnswer: The coffee shop in the community is scheduled to open at the end of the year, which is really the icing on the cake.
references: The coffee shop in the community is scheduled to open at the end of the year, which is really the icing on the cake.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: community“小区，社区”；be scheduled to do“定于做某事”；the icing on the cake“锦上添花”。

q70.sampleAnswer: A person must realize his strong and weak points before he can reasonably set up the goal for life and struggle for it without regrets or complaints.
references: A person must realize his strong and weak points before he can reasonably set up the goal for life and struggle for it without regrets or complaints.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “……之后才能……”可用 must ... before ...；without regrets or complaints“无怨无悔”，complaint 用复数。
